thread:
alex_support: FYI @channel — Brightleaf reports portal daily total for 2024-03-15 = 1,119,432 tokens but the raw usage export CSV sums to ~892k. Customer seeing a ~227k token delta. Raising for investigation.
emma_cs: Thanks Alex. Ticket #5821 has the customer's repro steps and the original CSV attached. They're asking why dashboard != export.
mike_billing: Checked ledger: invoice calc used 1,119,432 tokens (matches portal). So billing and portal aligned; export is lower.
olivia_data: Can you paste the S3 path for the export? I'll run a quick aggregate on raw data.
alex_support: s3://redwood-exports/brightleaf/2024-03-15/usage-agg.csv (attached). Export generated at 2024-03-16T01:05Z.
olivia_data: Ran `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM raw_usage WHERE day='2024-03-15' AND customer='brightleaf';` -> 892,134. The export file sums to 892,076 (rounding). So export == raw shards. Ledger showing 1,119,432 -> delta ~227,298.
ryan_ops: We had a midnight batch window restart on 2024-03-16T00:40Z due to a worker OOM; some aggregator commits retried. I'll check `agg_commit_log`.
olivia_data: Grepped `agg_commit_log` and found two commits for day=2024-03-15: `commit_id=a1b2` (primary) and `commit_id=a1b2-retry` (retry) with +227,298 tokens. The export job reads `committed_shards=primary_only`.
alex_support: So export job intentionally filters out `legacy-batcher`/retry commits? That would explain gap.
mike_billing: Historically exports read primary commits only to avoid double-counting partial replays. Looks like the retry was supposed to be promoted but promotion didn't happen. Ops, any idea why promotion stalled?
ryan_ops: Promotion service failed to mark the retry as promoted because the commit reconciler timed out during a DB failover that coincided with the OOM. There's an incident INC-4892; ledger aggregator uses `union_commits=true` so billing picked up the retry. Export service still used `primary_only`.
olivia_data: Quick fix: run export job with `--include-retries=true`. Example: `python export_runner.py --bucket brightleaf --date 2024-03-15 --include-retries` — locally this produces sum ~1,119,470 (close to ledger, ~38 token diff).
emma_cs: Customer on call in 10. Recommend: (1) re-run export and attach corrected CSV, (2) proactively credit the delta, (3) explain root cause and mitigation.
mike_billing: Agreed. Preliminary credit calc: (227,298 tokens / 1000) * $0.12 = ~$27.27. I'll verify tiering and apply provisional credit.
ryan_ops: Scheduling backfill: `backfill_aggs --start 2024-03-15 --end 2024-03-15 --mode promote-retries`. Job queued, expected to finish ~12m. Will ping when complete.
billing-bot: Invoice for Brightleaf (2024-03-15) reconciled. Amount unchanged. Note: credits require manual apply. @mike_billing
mike_billing: Applied provisional $27.24 credit to customer account pending final verification.
alex_support: Re-run complete, new CSV: s3://redwood-exports/brightleaf/2024-03-15/usage-agg-v2.csv. Also available via API: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/export?date=2024-03-15&customer=brightleaf"`
olivia_data: Verified sums: ledger vs new export match within 40 tokens. Pushed a patch to export service to set `include_retries=true` by default for 30 days while we audit older runs.
emma_cs: I updated the customer: offered $30 goodwill credit, explained cause (retry promotion edge-case during OOM/db failover), customer accepted.
ryan_ops: Follow-ups: make commit reconciler idempotent, add unit tests for retry commits, and add monitoring on `promotion_latency`. Filing PRs and a postmortem entry.
alex_support: Thanks all — closing loop :thumbsup:
